action.description: Omit action for legacy send; explicit send requires approvalHash. prepare only reads a review snapshot/hash; status only reads the existing draft-send journal.

draftId.description: Real saved provider draft ID. Also the durable status/idempotency lookup key; reuse it on retries.

approvalHash.description: On send, compare live draft/sender/thread with this explicitly reviewed prepare hash before sending. Required for the DeepLine conditional-send workflow.

targetUserId.description: Only an org admin/owner may target another user in their organization. The user must explicitly authorize the sender, recipient and message. Applies to prepare/status too.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
